changelog: - **A saved diagram the app cannot read is no longer replaced without a word.** When the diagram saved in this browser could not be read — damaged, or saved by a newer version of Loop Studio — the app silently opened the sample instead, and the first change you made overwrote the saved diagram for good. Now the app does not start over it: a screen says the saved diagram could not be opened and nothing will be saved until you choose. You can download it exactly as it is, try reading it again, continue in a temporary session that leaves it untouched, or discard it after a confirmation. If the browser does not let the app read its storage at all, the same screen offers to try again or to continue in a temporary session. Switching a temporary session back to a personal one now checks the saved diagram first and refuses rather than overwrite one that cannot be opened.
